newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments up on last year.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments up on last year.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1, 1996, and January 7, 1997, were 33 percent above their year-ago level, mostly the result of higher wheat and barley sales, member-country officials said on Friday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain exports ahead on last year at 16.986 million tonnes against 12.743 million.
Commercial soft wheat export commitments reached 5.819 million tonnes, up from 4.290 million in the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports jumped to 3.372 million tonnes from 1.223 million, helped by sales to Saudi Arabia.
Flour exports were ahead on last year at 3.816 million tonnes against 2.953 million.
Malt exports rose to 2.353 million tonnes from 2.182 million.

Since January 7, the EU has authorised 260,000 tonnes of soft wheat, 178,273 tonnes of barley, 14,092 tonnes of rye, 33,00 tonnes of oats and 19,800 tonnes of durum wheat exports through its weekly grain tender system.
